metcons.name: Quick Spark

stimulus.feel: Short sprint. Hang cleans should be fast touch-and-go. Chest-to-bar pull-ups in quick sets or unbroken.
stimulus.intent: Barbell cycling speed, pulling under fatigue, short-duration intensity

metcons.coachNotes: Touch-and-go hang cleans if possible. C2B should be unbroken in round 1. If you're grinding singles on the bar from the start, go lighter. This should be a sprint, not a grind.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 8 min cap, the barbell is too heavy or pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Breeze

stimulus.feel: A true engine test. Find a pace you can hold for 20 minutes. The row sets the rhythm, the swings keep you honest, and the toes-to-bar test your midline under fatigue.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic capacity, pacing discipline, mixed modal endurance

metcons.coachNotes: This is a 20-minute pacer, not a sprint. Athletes should find their rhythm by round 3 and hold it. KB swings unbroken every round. TTB in 1-2 sets. Row at a sustainable pace. Target 7-10 rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 5 rounds means the KB or toes-to-bar are slowing you too much. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Heavy Slate

stimulus.feel: Heavy barbell complex with running. Low reps but challenging loads. The 200m between rounds stops you from resting too long. Push-ups accumulate under shoulder fatigue.
stimulus.intent: Strength endurance across barbell movements, pacing heavy loads with bodyweight volume

metcons.coachNotes: The run should be a jog, not a sprint. Save energy for the barbell. Same bar for both front squat and push press. Front squats from the floor (clean first rep each round). Push-ups should stay unbroken through at least round 3. Scale load to keep all movements unbroken every round.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the barbell is too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Cedar

stimulus.feel: Interval work. Push hard, recover within the minute. Cleans should be crisp, burpees are the engine piece. Should have 15-20s rest each round at Rx.
stimulus.intent: Power output under repeating time pressure, barbell skill under fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: Squat cleans should be crisp singles or quick touch-and-go. No grinding reps. If athletes can't finish within 40-45 seconds, reduce load or reps. The rest within each minute matters.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 15+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly finish after the 45 second mark, reduce load or reps by one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Flint

stimulus.feel: High intensity couplet. The descending reps give you hope, but the deadlifts get heavier as your grip fades. Burpees are relentless. Should hurt from round 2 onward.
stimulus.intent: High-intensity hip hinge under fatigue, mental toughness through descending reps

metcons.coachNotes: Deadlifts should be touch-and-go for the round of 21 at Rx. If you're dropping every rep from the start, go lighter. Burpees set the pace. Just keep moving.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 10 min cap, the deadlifts are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Long Tide

stimulus.feel: Steady engine work. No single movement should gas you. Find a rhythm and hold it for 25 minutes. The snatches are the separator.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic capacity, pacing discipline, sustained mixed modal output

metcons.coachNotes: This is a pacer, not a sprint. Athletes should be able to talk between movements. If the snatches slow to grinding singles, go lighter. Run should be conversational pace. Wall balls unbroken. Target 4-6 rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 3 rounds means the snatches or pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Granite

stimulus.feel: Gymnastics grinder. Four rounds means you need to pace the handstand push-ups from round 1. Pistols demand control. Toes-to-bar test your grip and midline when everything is tired.
stimulus.intent: Gymnastics skill under sustained fatigue, unilateral strength, coordination

metcons.coachNotes: HSPU in small sets from round 1. Don't burn out early. Pistols controlled, not rushed. TTB are where most athletes slow down. Scale to maintain quality movement across all 4 rounds. Target consistent round splits.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the gymnastics movements are too demanding. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Light Moss

stimulus.feel: Bodyweight grinder. Two rounds of the descending chipper. No equipment, no excuses. The second round is where character shows.
stimulus.intent: Bodyweight conditioning, sustained effort, mental toughness through repeated volume

metcons.coachNotes: Round 1 should feel manageable. Don't go out too hot. Round 2 starts right back at 50 DU, which is a mental challenge. Jumping lunges are where most athletes slow down. Scale to keep moving continuously through both rounds.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the volume is too high. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Chalk

stimulus.feel: Classic mixed modal grind with running. The 400m gives you a moment to breathe before hitting the thrusters. Your legs won't thank you after the box jumps. Find a pace and hold it.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal capacity, barbell cycling under fatigue, pacing with running

metcons.coachNotes: Use the run to recover, not to sprint. Thrusters in sets of 5-8. Don't go to failure in round 1. Box jumps steady and controlled. Scale load to keep moving through all 3 rounds.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the thrusters are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Loud Steel

stimulus.feel: Big and explosive. The rows bookend the barbell work. You'll need to find your pace on the erg knowing 30 clean and jerks are waiting. The second row is where mental toughness shows.
stimulus.intent: Engine capacity, explosive barbell cycling, pacing strategy

metcons.coachNotes: Don't blow up on the first row. Save energy for the barbell. C&J should be quick singles or small touch-and-go sets. The second row will feel harder than the first. That's normal. Settle in and hold a pace.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the clean and jerks are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Rust

stimulus.feel: Balanced pressing and pulling with running. Push press should be touch-and-go. Pull-ups in quick sets. The run is active recovery.
stimulus.intent: Upper body push/pull endurance, pacing with running

metcons.coachNotes: Push press unbroken through round 2 at least. Same pacing every round. If you're resting more than 5 seconds between movements, go lighter.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the push press is too heavy or pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Birch

stimulus.feel: Fast sprint. Row sets the pace, swings should be unbroken, burpees just keep moving. Transitions matter.
stimulus.intent: Short-duration power output, fast transitions

metcons.coachNotes: Row hard but don't empty the tank. KB swings unbroken every round. Burpees are the separator. Target sub-8 at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the pace is unsustainable at your level. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Long Copper

stimulus.feel: Long grinder. Five movements per round means constant transitions. No single movement should break you. The deadlifts accumulate over 30 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic capacity, pacing across multiple modalities, sustained output

metcons.coachNotes: This is a 30-minute test. Find your pace by round 2 and hold it. Wall balls unbroken. Deadlifts should be quick touch-and-go. Target 5-7 rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 4 rounds means the deadlifts are slowing you too much. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Iron

stimulus.feel: Heavy posterior chain grind. The run gives you time to breathe before the next round of deadlifts. Toes-to-bar test your grip after heavy pulling.
stimulus.intent: Posterior chain endurance, midline under fatigue, pacing heavy loads

metcons.coachNotes: Deadlifts should be touch-and-go in sets of 5 at minimum. If you're doing singles from the start, go lighter. TTB will get harder each round. Scale to keep quality.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the deadlifts are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Gravel

stimulus.feel: Chipper. Each piece builds on the last. The power cleans in the middle are the separator. Second set of wall balls feels different from the first.
stimulus.intent: Sustained output across varied movements, mental toughness through a long chipper

metcons.coachNotes: Don't sprint the first row. Wall balls should be unbroken. Power cleans in sets of 5 at minimum. The second row will feel harder. That's expected.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Frost

stimulus.feel: Interval work. Thruster minutes are the grind, toes-to-bar minutes test your midline. Should have 15-20s rest each minute at Rx.
stimulus.intent: Pressing power and midline stability under interval fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: Thrusters should be unbroken every round. If you can't finish in 40 seconds, reduce load or reps. TTB in 1-2 quick sets.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 20+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly finish after the 40 second mark, reduce load or reps by one level.

metcons.name: Heavy Brick

stimulus.feel: Heavy and long. The row sets the tempo. Front squats are the challenge. C2B pull-ups test your grip when your legs are shot. The short run at the end flushes the legs before the next round.
stimulus.intent: Strength endurance, heavy barbell under fatigue, mixed modal capacity

metcons.coachNotes: Row at 2:00/500m pace. Front squats from the floor (clean first rep). Break into sets of 4-6 if needed. C2B in quick sets. The run should be a recovery jog.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 22 min cap, the front squats or chest-to-bar are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Ash

stimulus.feel: Balanced 20-minute effort. The run anchors each round. Power snatches reward good technique under fatigue. Box jumps keep the heart rate up.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal capacity, Olympic lifting skill under fatigue, pacing

metcons.coachNotes: Run at 80% effort. Power snatches should be crisp. No grinding reps. If technique breaks down, go lighter. Box jumps steady and controlled. Target 5-7 rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 3 rounds means the snatches or box jumps are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Ember

stimulus.feel: Pulling and hinging grinder. C2B pull-ups tax the grip, KB swings tax the posterior chain, burpees are the engine. Four rounds means you need to pace.
stimulus.intent: Pulling endurance, hip hinge capacity, bodyweight conditioning

metcons.coachNotes: C2B in sets of 3-5. KB swings unbroken every round. Burpees are where you can push the pace. Scale to maintain quality C2B across all 4 rounds.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the chest-to-bar pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Salt

stimulus.feel: Classic couplet sprint. The descending reps give you hope. Thrusters burn the legs, pull-ups burn the grip. Go fast or go home.
stimulus.intent: High-intensity sprint, thruster cycling, pulling under fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: Thrusters unbroken in the round of 21 if possible. Pull-ups in big sets. This should be a sprint. If you're resting more than 10 seconds between movements, go lighter.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 8 min cap, the thrusters are too heavy or pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Storm

team.description: Alternate full rounds. One partner works while the other rests. Each partner completes 4 rounds.

stimulus.feel: Steady partner grind. Wall balls and running set the pace. TTB should be quick sets. Rest while your partner works, but stay warm.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal endurance with a partner. Pacing and transitions matter.

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner does 4 rounds. The rest between rounds should keep you fresh enough to push the pace. Wall balls unbroken every round. TTB in 1-2 sets max. Run should be a consistent effort, not a sprint.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 22 min cap as a team, one or both partners should drop one level.

metcons.name: Loud Waves

team.description: Alternate full rounds. One partner works while the other rests. Score is total rounds + reps for the team.

stimulus.feel: Moderate pace partner AMRAP. The cleans should be touch-and-go, box jumps fast. Row is recovery. Push the pace knowing you have built-in rest.
stimulus.intent: Barbell cycling and explosiveness with aerobic base, partner format

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner should aim for similar round times. HPC should be unbroken or fast doubles. Box jumps controlled but quick. Row is active recovery. Target 10-14 total rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 7 rounds as a team means the hang cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Cloud

team.description: Split the total work between partners however you choose. Only one partner works at a time.

stimulus.feel: High-volume partner chipper. Break up the work strategically. KB swings and wall balls should stay in big sets. Burpees are the grind. Row is the finisher.
stimulus.intent: Volume tolerance, work distribution strategy, mixed modal endurance

metcons.coachNotes: Partition however you want. Common strategy: alternate every 20-25 reps on wall balls and KB swings, every 10-15 on burpees. One person rows while the other rests. Total reps shown are for the TEAM.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 24 min cap, the volume is too high at your current level. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Thunder

team.description: Alternate full rounds. One partner works while the other rests. Each partner completes 5 rounds.

stimulus.feel: Fast barbell cycling with a push. Cleans should be crisp and fast. Push-ups are the recovery movement. Short rounds, high intensity.
stimulus.intent: Power output and barbell cycling speed in a team setting

metcons.coachNotes: Quick rounds. Power cleans should be touch-and-go or fast singles. Push-ups unbroken every round. Each round should take 30-50 seconds. Use the rest between rounds to recover and push hard.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Heavy River

team.description: Split the total work between partners however you choose. Only one partner works at a time on the barbell. Both can run simultaneously.

stimulus.feel: Heavy barbell chipper with running. The deadlifts and cleans are the grind. Double-unders test coordination under fatigue. Running is transition and recovery.
stimulus.intent: Strength endurance with barbell cycling, team work distribution

metcons.coachNotes: Total reps shown are for the TEAM. Each partner uses their own bar at their own weight. Common split: alternate every 10 reps on barbell movements. DUs can be split however. Run together or alternate laps.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 20 min cap, the barbell loads are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Gale

team.description: Alternate full rounds. One partner works while the other rests. Score is total rounds + reps for the team.

stimulus.feel: Balanced partner AMRAP. Thrusters are the grind, pull-ups test gymnastics under fatigue, row is pacing. Push knowing your partner is resting.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal capacity in a team format, pacing discipline

metcons.coachNotes: Thrusters should be unbroken or quick sets of 4. Pull-ups in 1-2 sets. Row at a strong but sustainable pace. Each round should take 1:30-2:00 at Rx. Target 12-16 total rounds.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 6 rounds as a team means the thrusters are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Ridge

stimulus.feel: Gymnastics grind. TTB and HSPU are the skill pieces. Running keeps the heart rate up. Should feel technical, not just cardio.
stimulus.intent: Gymnastics skill under fatigue, midline and pressing endurance

metcons.coachNotes: TTB in sets of 4-6 at Rx. HSPU strict or kipping, whatever keeps you moving. Scale HSPU aggressively to keep the workout under the cap. Run is recovery pace.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the HSPU or toes-to-bar are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Willow

stimulus.feel: Balanced mixed modal. KB swings set the pace, box jumps keep you explosive, C2B test your pulling. Should feel sustainable with consistent round times.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal conditioning, gymnastics pulling under moderate fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: KB swings unbroken every round. Box jumps controlled but quick. C2B in 1-2 sets. Find your rhythm by round 3 and hold it. Target 7-10 rounds at Rx.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 7 rounds means the chest-to-bar or box jumps are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Vine

stimulus.feel: Descending ladder. Each round gets shorter so the workout accelerates. Pull-ups are the limiter. Air squats and burpees should be unbroken throughout.
stimulus.intent: Gymnastics endurance, bodyweight conditioning, mental engagement through changing rep targets

metcons.coachNotes: The descending reps reward staying composed. Pull-ups will be the bottleneck for most. Break early in the 21s and 18s (sets of 7-9), then try to go unbroken from the 12s onward. Air squats and burpees should never break. The last three rounds are a sprint.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 20 min cap, the pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level for a faster sub.

metcons.name: Dark Thistle

stimulus.feel: E2MOM gymnastics intervals. Each 2-minute window has two movements. Work fast, rest within the window. Should have 30-40s rest each round.
stimulus.intent: Gymnastics skill under interval pressure, coordination and midline

metcons.coachNotes: E2MOM: 8 rounds alternating A/B (4 of each). Double-unders first to get the heart rate up, then gymnastics. If you can't finish in 80-90 seconds, scale the DU count.

goal.target: Complete all 8 rounds with 60+ seconds rest per 2 min window
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly finish after the 75 second mark, reduce reps by one level.

metcons.name: Long Meadow

stimulus.feel: Sunday easy engine. This is a conversation-pace workout. No movement should gas you. Find a rhythm and hold it for 30 minutes. Active recovery day.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic base building, active recovery, low-intensity steady state

metcons.coachNotes: Truly easy pace. You should be able to talk between movements. Run at 60-70% effort. Push-ups and air squats steady and unbroken. Row at a comfortable pace. This is about moving, not competing.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 4 rounds means the running is eating too much time. Drop one level for push-ups if needed.

metcons.name: Sweet Pebble

stimulus.feel: Easy Sunday grind. Low skill, moderate volume. Lunges and sit-ups are the work. Running and ring rows keep things moving. Conversation pace throughout.
stimulus.intent: Active recovery, bodyweight volume, low-intensity movement

metcons.coachNotes: Easy pace. Walking lunges controlled and even. Sit-ups at a steady rhythm. Ring rows with good body position. Run is a jog, not a run. No movement should feel hard.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 20 min cap, the volume is too high. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Light Dew

stimulus.feel: Light Sunday engine. Row sets the pace. KB swings and step-ups are low-skill, low-impact. Easy day, just move for 25 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Low-intensity aerobic work, active recovery with minimal impact

metcons.coachNotes: Easy and steady. Row at conversation pace. KB swings should feel light and easy. Box step-ups controlled, no jumping. This is about blood flow and recovery, not performance.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 8 rounds means the KB or step-ups are slowing you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Long Drift

stimulus.feel: Long bodyweight Sunday. Running is the backbone. Air squats, sit-ups, and push-ups fill the rounds. Easy, steady, no equipment needed.
stimulus.intent: Active recovery, aerobic volume, bodyweight endurance

metcons.coachNotes: Jog the 400m. Everything else at an easy, steady pace. Air squats unbroken. Sit-ups rhythmic. Push-ups in whatever sets keep you moving. No rushing, no resting. Just move.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 22 min cap, the running volume may be limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Oak

stimulus.feel: Alternating intervals. Push press minutes are the strength test, TTB minutes are the midline check. Should have 20+ seconds rest each minute.
stimulus.intent: Pressing power and midline stability under repeating time pressure

metcons.coachNotes: Push press should be touch-and-go, no re-racking. If you can't finish in 35 seconds, drop weight. TTB in 1-2 quick sets, kip aggressively.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 20+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly finish after the 40 second mark, reduce load or reps by one level.

metcons.name: Dark Fern

stimulus.feel: Gymnastics grind. Wall walks are the pacer. Double-unders and air squats are active recovery between them. Steady rhythm, not a sprint.
stimulus.intent: Shoulder endurance, midline stability, gymnastic stamina

metcons.coachNotes: Wall walks are the limiting factor. Go at a pace you can maintain for 18 minutes. Don't rush the descent. DU should be unbroken. Air squats are easy reps to keep moving.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 8 rounds means the wall walks are taking too long. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Loud Flame

stimulus.feel: Heavy grind with a running kicker. Deadlifts should be touch-and-go but heavy enough to demand focus. Bar-facing burpees punish you for going too fast on the deads. The run resets your breathing.
stimulus.intent: Posterior chain under fatigue, mixed modal capacity

metcons.coachNotes: Deadlifts in sets of 6 if needed, but try to go unbroken. Bar-facing burpees at a steady pace. Don't sprint the run. Use it to recover for the next round of deadlifts.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 20 min cap, the deadlift is too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Creek

team.description: Alternate full rounds. 3 rounds each. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Partner grind. Each partner does 3 rounds with built-in rest. KB swings and wall balls keep the heart rate up. The run forces you outside your comfort zone between rounds.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal conditioning with a partner, high sustained effort

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner does 3 full rounds, alternating. Built-in rest while your partner works. KB swings unbroken. Wall balls in 1-2 sets max. Run at 85% effort. Partners can use different loads.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 24 min cap, the KB swings or wall balls are slowing you down. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Light Rain

stimulus.feel: Sunday recovery engine. Low intensity, no barbell. Rowing is the anchor. Walking lunges open the hips. Box step-ups keep the legs moving. Conversational pace throughout.
stimulus.intent: Active recovery, aerobic base, low-impact movement

metcons.coachNotes: This is not a race. Keep a steady, sustainable pace. Row at 60-65% effort. Walking lunges should feel like a stretch, not a burn. Box step-ups controlled and deliberate.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 5 rounds means the row or lunges are too challenging. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Stone

stimulus.feel: Fast barbell couplet. Front squats should be unbroken at Rx. C2B in quick sets. This is a sprint, not a grind.
stimulus.intent: Squatting under fatigue, high-skill pulling, fast turnover

metcons.coachNotes: Front squats unbroken every round at the right weight. C2B in sets of 5+ minimum. If you break either movement into singles, the weight is too heavy or the movement is too hard. Scale down.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the front squat is too heavy or the pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Hawk

team.description: Alternate full rounds. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Heavy partner AMRAP. Power cleans set the pace. Box jumps keep intensity high. Row is the engine check. Built-in rest between rounds.
stimulus.intent: Power output and mixed modal stamina with a partner

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner works a full round then rests. Power cleans should be touch-and-go or quick singles. Box jumps are rebounding at Rx, step-up for scaled. Row hard but not all-out. Partners can use different bars.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 6 total rounds means the power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Heavy Dust

stimulus.feel: Barbell cycling with a bodyweight chaser. Power snatches demand precision under fatigue. Push-ups and double-unders keep the pace honest.
stimulus.intent: Olympic lifting endurance, pressing stamina, coordination

metcons.coachNotes: Power snatches should be touch-and-go or very quick singles. Reset grip between reps if needed but don't rest. Push-ups strict and unbroken. DU unbroken every round.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the snatches are too heavy or too technical. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Sage

stimulus.feel: Classic bodyweight triplet. Pull-ups test your grip. Air squats keep the legs burning. Burpees are the constant. Simple, balanced, approachable.
stimulus.intent: Bodyweight conditioning, grip endurance, steady state effort

metcons.coachNotes: Pull-ups in quick sets of 5+. Air squats unbroken every round. Burpees at a consistent pace. Find a rhythm in round 2 and hold it for the rest.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 5 rounds means the pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Coal

stimulus.feel: Friday all-out grinder. Deadlifts punish the grip and posterior chain. Handstand push-ups test inverted pressing under fatigue. Rowing is the recovery movement. Long enough to demand pacing.
stimulus.intent: Posterior chain and pressing endurance, sustained high output

metcons.coachNotes: Deadlifts touch-and-go or quick singles. HSPU in sets of 3-5 at Rx. Row at 85% effort. This is 20 minutes of sustained work. Don't go all-out in round 1. Find your pace by round 3.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 3 rounds means the deadlift or HSPU is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Loud Sand

team.description: Split the work however you choose. Only one partner works at a time.

stimulus.feel: Big volume team chipper. Partition the reps however you want. Wall balls and sit-ups are high-rep grinders. KB swings keep the posterior chain engaged. Rowing is the engine test.
stimulus.intent: High volume partner work, strategy and communication

metcons.coachNotes: Plan your split before starting. Common strategy: alternate every 20-25 reps. Keep transitions fast. Wall balls are the bottleneck. KB swings should be unbroken in sets of 15-20. Row in 250-500m chunks.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 28 min cap, reduce reps or load by one level.

metcons.name: Light Clover

stimulus.feel: Easy Sunday. Running, lunges, ring rows, and box step-ups. No barbell, no high-skill movements. Just move well for 25 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Active recovery, aerobic base, joint-friendly movement

metcons.coachNotes: Conversational pace. Run at 60% effort. Lunges slow and controlled. Ring rows strict with a full squeeze at the top. Box step-ups deliberate. This is about moving, not racing.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 4 rounds means the volume is too much. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Thorn

stimulus.feel: Fast barbell couplet. Thrusters are light enough to go unbroken but heavy enough to burn. TTB test the midline between sets. Quick transitions, no standing around.
stimulus.intent: Barbell cycling speed, midline under fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: Thrusters unbroken every round at the right weight. If you break, go lighter. TTB in 1-2 sets. The workout should speed up, not slow down. Last two rounds should be the fastest.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the thrusters are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Timber

team.description: Alternate full rounds. 4 rounds each. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Barbell and gymnastics partner sprint. Hang power cleans are moderate weight, fast cycling. Burpees to target keep the intensity up. Double-unders test coordination under fatigue.
stimulus.intent: Barbell cycling and coordination with a partner

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner does 4 rounds. HPC should be touch-and-go. Burpees to target at a steady pace. DU unbroken if possible. Transitions between partners should be fast.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 22 min cap, the hang power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Quartz

stimulus.feel: Alternating pressing and gymnastics intervals. Push press minutes test overhead strength. Pistol squat minutes test balance and single-leg control. Should have 15-20 seconds rest each minute.
stimulus.intent: Overhead pressing endurance, unilateral leg strength under fatigue

metcons.coachNotes: Push press unbroken every minute. Pistols alternating legs. If you can't finish pistols in time, use the box. Don't rush the pistols. Quality reps over speed.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 15+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly can't finish within the minute, reduce load or reps by one level.

metcons.name: Quick Fog

stimulus.feel: Classic descending triplet. Pull-ups and burpees are the grind. 200m run between rounds clears the head. Each round gets shorter and faster.
stimulus.intent: Gymnastics pulling endurance, bodyweight conditioning

metcons.coachNotes: Pull-ups in big sets. Burpees at a consistent pace. The runs are short. Sprint them. You should finish faster each round. If the 15s feel harder than the 21s, you went too fast.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the pull-ups are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Loud Lava

stimulus.feel: Friday all-out. Squat cleans demand power and precision. Double-unders test coordination when fatigued. HSPU finish each round with pressing under blood flow. Heavy, explosive, demanding.
stimulus.intent: Olympic lifting under fatigue, mixed gymnastics capacity

metcons.coachNotes: Squat cleans should be singles or quick doubles. Don't try to touch-and-go at this weight. DU unbroken. HSPU in sets of 3-5 at Rx. Rest between squat cleans if needed, but keep the rest short.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the squat cleans or HSPU are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Coral

team.description: Alternate full rounds. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Approachable partner AMRAP. Power snatches are moderate. Box jumps keep the heart rate high. Air squats are active filler. Built-in rest between rounds.
stimulus.intent: Power output and conditioning with a partner

metcons.coachNotes: Power snatches should be quick singles or touch-and-go. Box jumps rebounding at Rx, step-up for scaled. Air squats fast and unbroken. Keep transitions between partners under 10 seconds.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 6 total rounds means the snatches are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Light Honey

stimulus.feel: Easy Sunday effort. Row, KB swings, and push-ups. No high skill, no barbell. Just keep moving at a pace you can hold for 25 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Active recovery, aerobic base, posterior chain maintenance

metcons.coachNotes: Row at 60% effort. KB swings should feel easy. Push-ups strict and controlled. If you're breathing hard, slow down. This is active recovery, not a test.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 5 rounds means the volume is too much for recovery. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Bone

stimulus.feel: Alternating barbell and bodyweight intervals. Front squat minutes demand leg drive. Burpee minutes keep the heart rate pegged. Should have 15-20 seconds rest each minute.
stimulus.intent: Squatting power under time pressure, sustained conditioning

metcons.coachNotes: Front squats from the rack. Unbroken every round. If you can't finish in 35-40 seconds, drop weight. Burpees at a steady pace. Don't sprint them. Save energy for the next squat minute.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 15+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you regularly can't finish within the minute, reduce load or reps by one level.

metcons.name: Thick Maple

team.description: Alternate full rounds. 3 rounds each. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Partner grind. Wall balls are the pacer. TTB test the midline. Running adds conditioning. 3 rounds each with built-in rest.
stimulus.intent: Mixed modal stamina, sustained effort with a partner

metcons.coachNotes: Wall balls in sets of 10+. TTB in sets of 5+. Run at 85% effort. Each partner does 3 rounds. Use the rest between rounds to recover, not to stand around.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 24 min cap, the TTB are slowing you down. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Heavy Soot

stimulus.feel: Heavy barbell couplet with a pulling chaser. Clean and jerks are the main event. Pull-ups keep the upper body engaged. Air squats flush the legs between rounds.
stimulus.intent: Olympic lifting endurance, full-body power output

metcons.coachNotes: C&J should be singles at Rx weight. Don't rush between reps. Pull-ups in quick sets. Air squats fast and unbroken. Rest only between rounds if needed, not between movements.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the clean and jerks are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Pearl

stimulus.feel: Gymnastics-heavy AMRAP. C2B test the pull. Pistol squats test balance and single-leg strength. Sit-ups are active recovery between the skill movements.
stimulus.intent: High-skill gymnastics endurance, unilateral leg strength

metcons.coachNotes: C2B in sets of 3-5 at Rx. Pistol squats alternating legs, controlled tempo. Sit-ups fast and unbroken. This is about skill under fatigue, not speed. Quality reps count more than round count.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 4 rounds means the C2B or pistols are too demanding. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Bark

stimulus.feel: Friday all-out classic triplet. Heavy deadlifts with burpees and box jumps. Fast descending reps. Each round gets heavier relative to fatigue. Sprint to the finish.
stimulus.intent: Posterior chain power, explosive capacity, all-out effort

metcons.coachNotes: Deadlifts touch-and-go in the 21s, quick singles allowed in the 9s when fatigued. Burpees at a steady pace. Box jumps fast, rebound if you can. The 9s should be a sprint.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the deadlift is too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Pine

team.description: Alternate full rounds. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Balanced partner AMRAP. Rowing sets the pace. Thrusters keep the legs and shoulders working. Pull-ups test the grip. Good variety, approachable intensity.
stimulus.intent: Full-body conditioning with a partner, sustained effort

metcons.coachNotes: Row at 85% effort. Thrusters unbroken at the right weight. Pull-ups in quick sets. Partners can use different bars and loads. Keep transitions under 10 seconds.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 6 total rounds means the thrusters or pull-ups are too demanding. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Long Hemp

stimulus.feel: Long Sunday engine builder. Running, KB swings, air squats, and burpees to target. Simple movements, long duration. Find a pace and hold it for 30 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic endurance, pacing discipline, mental toughness

metcons.coachNotes: This is a 30-minute effort. Do not sprint. Run at 65-70% effort. KB swings light and unbroken. Air squats fast. Burpees to target at a steady, sustainable pace. If you're gasping, slow down.

goal.scaleDown: Fewer than 5 rounds means the pace is unsustainable. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Flax

stimulus.feel: Fast barbell couplet. Hang power cleans are moderate weight, fast cycling. Box jumps keep the legs working. Descending reps, sprint the last round.
stimulus.intent: Barbell cycling speed, explosive leg power

metcons.coachNotes: HPC should be unbroken every round. If you break, go lighter. Box jumps fast, rebound at Rx. Step-up for scaled athletes. The 9s should take under 90 seconds.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the hang power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Horn

team.description: Alternate full rounds. 4 rounds each. While one partner works, the other rests.

stimulus.feel: Barbell and engine partner grind. Power cleans demand power. Burpees are the constant. Rowing flushes the legs. 4 rounds each with built-in rest.
stimulus.intent: Power output and conditioning with a partner

metcons.coachNotes: Power cleans touch-and-go or quick singles. Burpees at a steady pace. Row at 85% effort. Each partner does 4 rounds. Keep transitions fast.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 24 min cap, the power cleans are too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Wool

stimulus.feel: Alternating Olympic lifting and KB intervals. Power snatch minutes demand precision. KB swing minutes keep the posterior chain engaged. Should have 20+ seconds rest each minute.
stimulus.intent: Olympic lifting skill under fatigue, hip hinge endurance

metcons.coachNotes: Power snatches as singles with a quick reset. Don't rush the setup. KB swings Russian, to eye level, unbroken every round. Both movements are hip-dominant. Focus on hinge quality.

goal.target: Complete all 16 minutes with 20+ seconds rest each round
goal.scaleDown: If you can't finish within the minute, the snatch is too heavy. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Dark Claw

stimulus.feel: Gymnastics chipper per round. Rope climbs are the skill test. Double-unders keep the heart rate up. Walking lunges burn the legs between climbs. Technical and physical.
stimulus.intent: Rope climbing endurance, coordination under fatigue, leg stamina

metcons.coachNotes: Rope climbs with a controlled descent. Don't slide down. DU unbroken if possible. Walking lunges slow and deliberate. For athletes who can't rope climb, 4 strict pull-ups is the sub.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the rope climbs or DU are limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Comet

stimulus.feel: Snatch fast and light, burpees over the bar smooth. Keep moving.
stimulus.intent: Barbell speed and engine under a sprint

metcons.coachNotes: Touch-and-go snatches where possible. Step over the bar if heart rate spikes. This is a sprint, not a grind.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 10 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Spruce

stimulus.feel: Thrusters in 1-2 sets, toes-to-bar in quick sets.
stimulus.intent: Squat-to-overhead cycling with a midline finisher

metcons.coachNotes: Break thrusters before failure. Keep toes-to-bar rhythmic. Consistent round splits.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Heavy Anvil

stimulus.feel: Heavier cleans in fast singles or small sets, push-ups unbroken early.
stimulus.intent: Power off the floor with a pressing pump

metcons.coachNotes: Cleans should feel heavy but moving. Reset fast. Push-ups in 1-2 sets.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 12 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Quick Gust

stimulus.feel: Pure sprint. Pick paces you can hold for all 8 minutes.
stimulus.intent: Fast monostructural and midline turnover

metcons.coachNotes: Russian swings to eye level. Unbroken sit-ups. Keep transitions tight.

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 6 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.name: Heavy Ingot

stimulus.feel: Front squats from the floor, pull-ups in quick sets.
stimulus.intent: Front-rack strength-endurance with vertical pulling

metcons.coachNotes: Front squats unbroken if you can. Break pull-ups early to avoid failure.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sweet Brook

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 7 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.name: Sweet Delta

stimulus.feel: Wall balls unbroken, toes-to-bar in quick sets, row steady.
stimulus.intent: Balanced squat-pull-engine triplet

metcons.coachNotes: Smooth wall balls, controlled kip on toes-to-bar, hold a strong row split.

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 7 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.name: Thick Shale

stimulus.feel: Big sets, low skill. Keep grinding at a steady clip.

metcons.coachNotes: Russian swings unbroken, sit-ups steady, air squats smooth. No wasted rest.

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 6 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.name: Dark Talon

metcons.coachNotes: Break HSPU before failure. Toes-to-bar in controlled sets. Protect the shoulders.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Sharp Mesa

stimulus.feel: Pull-ups in quick sets, wall balls unbroken, run a steady clip.
stimulus.intent: Mixed-modal pulling, squatting and engine

metcons.coachNotes: Hold round splits. Don't blow up the run early. Pull-ups before failure.

metcons.name: Dark Crag

stimulus.feel: Wall walks slow and controlled, toes-to-bar smooth, swings unbroken.

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 6 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.name: Loud Forge

stimulus.feel: Classic couplet sprint. Thrusters and burpees over the bar.
stimulus.intent: Lactate tolerance, all-out finish

metcons.coachNotes: 21-15-9. Push the pace from rep one. Big breaths over the bar, then go.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 14 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Thick Basalt

stimulus.feel: Deadlifts in touch-and-go sets, wall balls unbroken.
stimulus.intent: Posterior-chain grind with a squat finisher

metcons.coachNotes: Keep a flat back on the deadlifts. Drop and reset if the back rounds. Wall balls smooth.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 18 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

metcons.name: Spicy Cinder

stimulus.feel: Power cleans fast, burpees over the bar relentless.
stimulus.intent: Barbell power with a high-intensity finish

metcons.coachNotes: Cleans in small sets or quick singles. Don't stall on the burpees.

goal.scaleDown: If you hit the 16 min cap, the load or skill is limiting you. Drop one level.

stimulus.feel: Run, thrusters, chest-to-bar. Hold a hard but repeatable pace.
stimulus.intent: All-out mixed-modal engine

metcons.coachNotes: Thrusters before failure, chest-to-bar in quick sets, attack the run.

goal.scaleDown: If you fall well short of 6 rounds, drop a level.

metcons.coachNotes: This is a recovery piece. Nose-breathing pace. Never redline. Smooth transitions.

metcons.coachNotes: Keep the heart rate low. Walk the run if needed. Quality positions over speed.

metcons.name: Long Canyon

stimulus.feel: One long sustained effort. Settle into a rhythm and hold it.
stimulus.intent: Aerobic endurance and pacing discipline

team.description: Alternate full rounds. One partner works while the other rests. Each partner completes 4 rounds.

stimulus.feel: Partner grind. Push your working round, recover while your partner goes.
stimulus.intent: Mixed-modal partner endurance

metcons.coachNotes: Each partner does 4 rounds. Wall balls unbroken, toes-to-bar in 1-2 sets, run a steady clip.

stimulus.feel: Big shared totals. Break the reps to keep both partners moving fast.
stimulus.intent: Partner volume and pacing

metcons.coachNotes: Partition the row by distance and the swings/squats by sets. Communicate and keep the bar moving.

stimulus.intent: Synchronized partner engine

metcons.coachNotes: Partner A rows while Partner B does the swings and wall balls, then swap. Keep both stations busy.
